name: Campingplatz Kupferschmiede
beschreibung:
Campingplatz Kupferschmiede impresses with its idyllic green setting and close proximity to varied leisure activities. Guests appreciate the welcoming family atmosphere, well-maintained sanitary facilities, and generous pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents.

The surrounding area invites visitors to enjoy extended walks, cycling tours, and alpine mountain hikes. With its convenient yet peaceful location, the campsite serves as an excellent base for exploring alpine nature and top regional attractions.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Kupferschmiede offers natural camping with modern amenities and an ideal starting point for alpine excursions.
